title: Singular difference graphs of vector spaces of square matrices
summary: The singular difference graph, denoted by $Γ$, of the vector space of square matrices over a field is a graph whose vertex set is the set of all elements of the vector space, where two distinct vertices are adjacent if and only if the difference of the corresponding matrices is singular. In this paper, we investigate fundamental graph-theoretic properties of $Γ$, including connectivity, diameter, regularity, the Eulerian property, independence number, clique number, and domination number.
